tools.description: Get one countdown by id. Returns id, title, next_target_time, next_remaining_seconds, repeat, enabled, and a server-computed expired flag (based on next_remaining_seconds). For how long until / next fire, use next_* only. Use when the id is already known.
tools.name: get_countdown

tools.description: Return the single nearest countdown that has not expired yet (next_remaining_seconds >= 0), chosen by the server. Use when the user asks which is next, nearest, soon due, or how long until the next one — read next_target_time / next_remaining_seconds on the result. Do not use list_countdowns for that. If none are upcoming, returns {"countdown":null} — do not pick an expired one.
tools.name: get_next_countdown

tools.description: List countdowns sorted by next_remaining_seconds (upcoming first). Each item includes a server-computed expired flag (next_remaining_seconds < 0). Use when the user asks what exists, which have expired, or wants to browse. Do not use this to answer which is nearest/next — call get_next_countdown instead. For how long until / next fire, use next_target_time and next_remaining_seconds. Returns id, title, next_target_time, next_remaining_seconds, repeat, enabled, expired.

within_hours.description: Only return countdowns due within this many hours (0 <= next_remaining_seconds <= within_hours*3600)

tools.name: list_countdowns
